# `device.create`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/device.create.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`device.create`: a device without a representation (FR-DEV-001), optionally with its main function.

Creates `Device {tag: {letter, counter}, kind, parts, function_text, structure, strip aspect}` and, with
`main_fndef`, `Function {device, def: main_fndef, role: main, kind: normal}`. An explicit `counter` is
kept (a typed tag); without one the device stays unnumbered until its main function is placed (online
numbering, normaliser #4). The part copies and the FnDef copy must exist. Outcome: the device.

## Types

### CmdIdent

An identifier: non-empty, one line, NFC, without leading or trailing white space (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### CmdMlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags in ascending order with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### DeviceKind

A device's UI and numbering hint. Doc 03 enumerates only these kinds so far; others are kept as
`DeviceKind::Unknown` until the list is decided.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"psu"` | Power supply. |
| `"terminal"` | Terminal. |
| `"blanking_plate"` | Blank manifold or valve-terminal position (doc 11 §2.7). |

### PartUse

A part use on a device (ADR-0006): the part and its quantity in the part's order unit.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `part` | [`PartRef`](#partref) | yes |  | The part. |
| `qty` | [`Dec3`](#dec3) | yes |  | The quantity in the part's order unit (pieces, metres, sets). |

### Dec3

A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader.

Type: string (at most 21 character(s))

Pattern: `^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,15}(?:\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])?|-?0\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])$`

### PartRef

A part on a device (doc 03 §7): the embedded copy and an optional part variant (FR-PRT-003).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `copy` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The copy ID of the embedded part, `v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`. |
| `variant` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | A variant key of the part. |

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### Strip

The `Strip` aspect (doc 03 §11).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accessories` | array of [`StripAccessory`](#stripaccessory) | no |  | Accessories in mounting order (FR-TRM-016). |
| `designation_scheme` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | Terminal designation scheme (FR-NUM-024). |
| `field_side` | [`Side`](#side) | no |  | The terminal side facing the field; default side 2 (FR-TRM-012). |
| `groups` | array of [`TerminalGroup`](#terminalgroup) | no |  | Range captions ("Pneumatics", "Spare"; FR-TRM-010). |
| `label_mode` | [`LabelMode`](#labelmode) | no |  | What terminals print; default the designation. |
| `tag_print` | [`TagPrint`](#tagprint) | no |  | Where the strip tag prints; default once per segment. |

### LabelMode

What the terminals of a strip print.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"designation"` | The terminal designation (the default). |
| `"function_text"` | The terminal's function text ("1+", FR-TRM-021). |

### Side

A terminal side (doc 08 §2.1: side 1 is internal and side 2 external unless `Strip.field_side` says
otherwise).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"side1"` | Side 1. |
| `"side2"` | Side 2. |

| `kind` | [`AccessoryKind`](#accessorykind) | yes |  | The accessory kind. |

Kind of a strip accessory.

|---|---|

### StructureAssignment

Which structure node a page, device or structure box belongs to, one slot per aspect (doc 03 §5).
Members follow the canonical aspect order of `ew_rds::Aspect`; the product aspect is the device tree and
has no slot.

```
use ew_schema::StructureAssignment;

let s: StructureAssignment = serde_json::from_str(
    r#"{"function":"7d2c95e0-1f4a-5b38-a6e7-0c93b5d1f284","location":"none"}"#,
).unwrap();
assert!(s.installation_site.is_none()); // absent: inherit
```

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `document_kind` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `&` (pages only). |
| `function` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `=` |
| `functional_assignment` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `==` |
| `installation_site` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `++` |
| `location` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `+` |
| `type` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `%` |
| `user_defined` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `#` |

### Slot

A structure slot: a structure node ID or "none"; absent means inherit (doc 05 §3.2).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: [`Uuid`](#uuid)

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: `"none"`

Where a strip prints its tag (FR-TRM-011).

|---|---|

| `"per_page"` | Once per page. |

### MlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
